text:
Marco: Heads-up — SecureCall Gateway (SCG) is GA for Hosted API today. Its a streaming gateway that adds per-tool-call signatures, optional payload attestation, and automatic confidential routing for sensitive tool outputs. Opt-in via Console -> Endpoints. :shield:

Sana: Nice. Is this mainly for regulated customers or general use?

Marco: Both. Primary wins: tamper-evidence for tool responses, easier audit trails, and a confidential mode that routes specific tool traffic to isolated compute. Good for finance/health use cases.

Ivy: Ops note — were starting with a 24h canary in us-west-2. I updated the runbook with signature verification troubleshooting steps.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollout/securecall-ga: started (canary clusters: us-west-2) at 2900001165. canary_replicas=3.

Sana: Migration highlights / breaking changes? Anything SDK-wise?

Marco: Endpoint is `/v1/securecall/stream`. New header `X-Signature-Mode: off|verify|enforce`. Frames include an extra metadata frame `tool_sig` when signatures are enabled. JS/py SDKs have non-breaking patches that expose `verify_tool_signature()` helper.

Ivy: infra-bot: infra-bot: added synthetic that verifies signed frames and checks attestation headers. Also added a dashboard for signature failure rate and confidential-routing telemetry.

Sana: Example curl for support docs?

Marco: Quick example:

Marco: ```bash
Marco: curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
Marco:   -H "X-Signature-Mode: verify" \
Marco:   -d '{"model":"scg-mini-1","enable_confidential":true,"tools":["doc-lookup","payment-connector"]}' \
Marco:   https://api.redwood.ai/v1/securecall/stream
Marco: ```

Ivy: deploy-bot: rollout/securecall-ga: canary health=ok (2900001220). scheduling wider rollout after 12h observation.

Sana: Billing / quotas?

Marco: Billing: Secure units = tokens + signature_overhead. Default streaming quota: 10 rps per key for signed streams; confidential routing subject to Dedicated/private availability. Customers can request higher quotas in Console.

Sana: Deprecations?

Marco: We will deprecate the legacy unauthenticated tool-call endpoint `toolcall-v1` in 45 days. We will provide an automated assist tool to help customers add signatures to outgoing tool integrations.

Ivy: Ops: I uploaded the troubleshooting checklist and signature verification scripts to the infra docs. Also scheduled a 30m walkthrough for Support tomorrow 10am PT.

Marco: Docs: https://console.redwood.ai/docs/securecall-gateway-migration — migration guide, sample helpers, and compatibility notes are live.

Sana: I'll update the customer-facing release notes and notify our HIPAA beta partners.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollout/securecall-ga: global rollout initiated (2900001280).

Marco: Thanks all — please monitor #eng-runtime and tag me for any escalations. Town hall Friday 9am PT to demo signing flows and attestation reports. :rocket:
